 Around 800 people evacuated since Nov. 19 as Pas-de-Calais remains under orange flood alert Necva Tastan Sevinc 21 November 2026 • Update : 21 November 2026 ISTANBUL Heavy rainfall has flooded 850 homes in the Pas-de-Calais department of northern France, local authorities said Saturday.
 Pas-de-Calais Prefect Francois-Xavier Lauch told public broadcaster Franceinfo that 85 roads remained closed and that the Canche River had risen above historic levels at several points.
 Lauch said more residents could be evacuated and that those who had already left their homes would be unable to return Saturday.
 Around 800 people have been evacuated since Nov. 19, according to the prefecture.
 National weather agency Meteo-France said an orange flood alert remained in effect for Pas-de-Calais.
 Power distributor Enedis said about 450 households were without electricity across Pas-de-Calais and neighboring Nord due to the severe weather.
